item: row 164+165: task manager AI pill shares the app's off mark and hover; context and investigate bucket accents
summary: The task manager's AI pill showed offline by colour alone. Both pages now take class and hover from ooAiPillState in ai-pill.js, so offline is the red pill with the diagonal bar and a hover naming why. The task-manager click opens Settings > AI via a #models alias. Context and investigate briefing cards get theme-derived left-border accents like the other six buckets.
